cases.prompt: Save a routine named Hourly case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every hour, for at most 2 runs. Use only the schedule, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

Save a routine named Quarter-hour case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every 15 minutes, for at most 2 runs. Use only the schedule, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.
Save a routine named Daily case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every 24 hours, for at most 2 runs. Use only the interval, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

Save a routine named Changed case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE when case records change, for at most 2 runs. Use case events only, with no periodic schedule. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.
